newsitem.title: FRENCH GUIANA: Ariane launches satellites for Arab bloc, Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Ariane launches satellites for Arab bloc, Malaysia.

text.p: Western Europe's 92nd Ariane rocket blasted off from French Guiana on Wednesday carrying satellites for the 21-nation Arab League and Malaysia.
The Ariane 44L rocket lifted off at 7:40 p.m./5:40 p.m. EDT (2240 GMT) into a partly cloudy equatorial night sky.
Twenty minutes after takeoff space officials said the ARABSAT 2B satellite separated from the rocket. Five minutes later MEASAT 2 for Malaysia's satellite operator Binariang was released into space.

The launch was the fifth Ariane mission since the failure of an Ariane-5 rocket on June 4, the first of a new generation, 37 seconds after its maiden launch from the European Space Agency (ESA) launch centre in Kourou, French Guiana on the northeast coast of South America.
